description: This file defines a class that represents and validates CSS length values within an HTML purifier library. The class manages length constraints and includes validation logic for CSS length attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Length
classes.description: A class that models a CSS Length attribute for HTML purification, providing validation against specified minimum and maximum length constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance of the class with optional minimum and maximum length bounds.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a CSS length string against the defined length constraints, returning either the length as a string or false if validation fails.
